# Gemini for Windows

> Unofficial, free, open-source app for Windows 10/11 (MIT license). It opens Google AI Mode (google.com/search?udm=50, Google Search's AI chat powered by Gemini) as a real desktop app: its own Microsoft Edge window, Desktop shortcut and taskbar icon, everything in one portable folder. The search tabs (Images, Videos, News), the sources column and extra buttons are hidden and the chat is centered. Extras: voice input in 50+ languages with commands ("send", "clear") and an interface language switch. Not affiliated with Google.

Key facts:
- Install: download Gemini-portable.zip from https://github.com/ishimuraxxx-ai/gemini-1.0.1/releases/latest, unzip, run Gemini.exe; a Gemini shortcut appears on the Desktop.
- Requirements: Windows 10 or 11 with Microsoft Edge. A Google account is optional (sign in to keep chat history). Not available for macOS or Linux.
- Shortcuts: Ctrl+Space starts/stops dictation, Ctrl+, opens settings (interface and dictation language).
- Transparency: Gemini.exe is built by GitHub Actions from public source (about 70 lines of C#), with SHA-256 checksums and a GitHub build-provenance attestation. No telemetry.
- Common issue: AI Mode is not available in every country; a VPN to a supported country is needed there.

## Source

- [extension/voice.js](https://github.com/ishimuraxxx-ai/gemini-1.0.1/blob/main/extension/voice.js): voice input, settings, centered chat (Edge extension)
- [extension/hide.css](https://github.com/ishimuraxxx-ai/gemini-1.0.1/blob/main/extension/hide.css): what is hidden on the AI Mode page
- [launcher/Gemini.cs](https://github.com/ishimuraxxx-ai/gemini-1.0.1/blob/main/launcher/Gemini.cs): source of Gemini.exe
- [Releases](https://github.com/ishimuraxxx-ai/gemini-1.0.1/releases): downloads
